verdict.rationale: Ashby documents its own permission levels, which can be scoped globally or to specific departments and jobs. That supports visibility rules for the hiring team. Notes and feedback exist as records, but only via the MCP data-surface listing, not as a documented collaboration feature, and there is no evidence of @mentions or tasks. Slack integration is an adjacent channel and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: @mentions, shared-note collaboration docs, task assignment, explicit scoping of sensitive interview feedback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the hiring team collaborates in the ATS — @mentions, shared notes, tasks, and visibility rules that keep sensitive feedback scoped

citations.quote: Permission levels can be set globally or within specific departments, jobs, and other organizational data.
Search and retrieve recruiting context across candidates, applications, jobs, job postings, interviews, offers, notes, feedback, emails, referrals, hiring teams, and other recruiting records.
